messages:
Sana (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we've updated the employee expense reimbursement policy for remote work stipends. Please read the summary and complete the 3-question compliance quiz by Friday EOD. Links below.
Omar (Benefits): TL;DR? What's changed vs last year?
Sana (People Ops): main changes: 1) monthly stipend caps clarified per country, 2) receipts no longer required for micro-allowances under $50, 3) added a short self-cert that you used funds for work-related expenses.
Eleanor: Thanks — do we need manager sign-off for past months or only going forward?
Sana (People Ops): only going forward. retro claims window closed last month. Managers will see an "acknowledged" flag after you complete the quiz.
Kai (Eng): link to the quiz?
hr-bot: New policy summary uploaded: https://intranet.redwood.ai/policies/remote-expense-v2.pdf
hr-bot: Compliance quiz: https://learn.redwood.ai/quiz/remote-expense-v2 (3 questions, ~2min). Completion auto-logs to HR.
Ravi: If someone is in EU, are the caps different?
Omar (Benefits): Yes — caps vary by country. See table on page 2 of the PDF. If you want I can post a quick breakdown for UK/EU folks separately.
Eleanor: Can confirm, completed the quiz. Manager ack showed up right away. :white_check_mark:
Kai (Eng): Done. Quick note: the quiz redirect briefly showed a 502 but retried and worked. Heads-up to infra?
Sana (People Ops): thanks — Omar, can you check the quiz availability? If infra needs a page rule tweak, we'll ping eng-infra.
Omar (Benefits): I'll verify with learning-platform team and report back by EOD.
Sana (People Ops): Appreciate it. If anyone needs a PDF summary tailored to contractors, DM me and I'll prepare one. :memo:
